articulation.label: afternoon
articulation.alt: afternoon: /æ/ → /f/ → /t/ → /ɚ/ → /n/ → /u/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
